entities.name: Juan Ortega y Montañés
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Juan Ortega y Montañés was a Roman Catholic bishop and colonial administrator in Guatemala and New Spain. He was successively bishop of Durango, of Guatemala and of Michoacán, and then archbishop of Mexico. He also served as interim viceroy of New Spain from February 27, 1696, to December 18, 1696, and again from November 4, 1701, to November 27, 1702.
